episodes.title: Episodio 55
episodes.synopsis: Subaru and Beatrice encounter Al outside the Water Hagoromo Pavilion. Subaru is puzzled by Al's behavior of treating him as a "brother" despite being from a different camp. Subaru's perception is different from what he expected, and Al mutters softly, "Do you need a hint...?"

episodes.title: Episodio 56
episodes.synopsis: Subaru finds himself in a humorous situation as he attempts to adapt to his new role in the mansion. The episode showcases his interactions with the mansion's staff and his efforts to fit in, all presented in the series' signature chibi art style. While the episode doesn't advance the main plot, it provides fans with a delightful and comedic interlude.

episodes.title: Episodio 57
episodes.synopsis: The characters participating in the Royal Selection event gather for a social meet-up filled with lively and humorous interactions. The episode highlights the personalities and quirks of the candidates and their supporters as they engage in playful banter and lighthearted competitions. The tone is comedic and charming, focusing on the bonds and rivalries that develop among the group during this important event.

episodes.title: Episodio 58
episodes.synopsis: The candidates for the royal selection and their followers engage in more playful competitions and conversations, each trying to showcase their unique charms and strengths. The episode focuses on character interactions filled with humorous misunderstandings, friendly rivalry, and heartwarming moments that deepen the bonds between the characters.

episodes.title: Episodio 59
episodes.synopsis: The spotlight is on Emilia and her party as they face the everyday challenges and comedic mishaps of adventuring together. From misunderstandings to the quirks of each party member, the episode humorously showcases the group’s dynamics and the small struggles they encounter while trying to work as a team.

episodes.title: Episodio 60
episodes.synopsis: The characters prepare for a theatrical performance filled with humorous anticipation and behind-the-scenes antics. The episode follows the cast as they rehearse and navigate the comedic challenges that come with putting on a show—miscommunications, forgotten lines, and over-the-top acting all contribute to the fun.

episodes.title: Episodio 61
episodes.synopsis: the episode dives into the romantic and sometimes awkward interactions between the characters, presenting a series of short, sweet, and comedic vignettes. Using the chibi art style, the episode highlights moments of affection, misunderstandings, and playful teasing among the main cast.

episodes.title: Episodio 62
episodes.synopsis: Petra is asked by Roswaal to search for the chef who has run away. While walking through the garden, she finds a person buried in the shrubbery, and it turns out to be Diaz, the chef she is looking for! It seems that Diaz ran away because he wasn't interested. In response, Petra remembers her conversation with Ram and tries to persuade him that "you can't keep running away."

episodes.title: Episodio 63
episodes.synopsis: As Otto heads to Pristella, Petra, Frederica, and Ram, acting as his advisors, emphasize various requests to him. As Otto feels down because he is left to his own devices and no one is concerned about him, Emilia appears before him..

episodes.title: Episodio 64
episodes.synopsis: Ram appears before Otto in a sulky mood. It seems that Roswaal is avoiding her... Otto asks if anything has changed recently, and Ram tells Roswaal, "I love you."

episodes.title: Episodio 65
episodes.synopsis: Ram appears before Otto in a sulky mood. It seems that Roswaal is avoiding her... Otto asks if anything has changed recently, and Ram tells Roswaal, "I love you."

episodes.title: Episodio 66
episodes.synopsis: Petra is shocked when Roswaal reveals his "weakness" to her at a dinner party. Diaz then tries to give her something...

episodes.title: Episodio 67
episodes.synopsis: Roswaal returns to the castle with Frederica and Petra after the meeting. Ram, who had been left in charge, rushes to Roswaal's side, seizing the opportunity.

episodes.title: Episodio 68
episodes.synopsis: Petra keeps Meili company while she's locked up in the dungeon. Petra makes a request to Meili, who is always saying mean things.

episodes.title: Episodio 69
episodes.synopsis: Anastasia has been taken over by an artificial spirit. Beatrice receives a shocking confession from Subaru. Emilia comes to Beatrice, who is observing Anastasia with Subaru...

episodes.title: Episodio 70
episodes.synopsis: Emilia and the others are worried about Subaru and Ram, who won't wake up. Then Ram wakes up...

related.title: Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu
related.plot: Natsuki Subaru, un normale studente delle superiori, incontra una splendida ragazza dai capelli argentei proveniente da un altro mondo. Subaru vuole stare al suo fianco e aiutarla, ma il fardello che lei porta è ben oltre qualsiasi cosa Subaru immagini. I due sono messi di fronte ad attacchi di mostri uno dopo l altro, tradimento, violenza irrazionale? e infine morte. Subaru non vuole che la ragazza rimanga ferita, per questo fa voto di abbattere ogni nemico, ogni fato avverso, allo scopo di proteggerla. Così questo ragazzo senza poteri ottiene "Ritorno tramite Morte" un abilità unica che gli permette di riavvolgere il tempo morendo. Diventa la possibile guida di tutti verso un mondo dove ognuno possa sorridere sempre, a scapito dalla vita e solitudine di Subaru. Usando il potere, il passato può essere perso e i ricordi possono essere riscritti. Subaru ora deve combattere il destino che lo condanna a tenere dentro di sé tutti quei ricordi perduti, a essere perennemente sconfitto, a vedere il proprio cuore consumato, a scommettere la propria vita? tutto per proteggere coloro a cui tiene. Per recuperare i preziosi momenti che lui è sicuro ci siano stati.

related.title: Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu - Memory Snow
related.plot: Subaru e i suoi amici sconfiggono il demone Wolgarm, la fonte della maledizione, salvando così i bambini del villaggio di Irlam. Arriva finalmente il momento di rilassarsi un po’, ma Subaru parte per una certa missione segreta, il cui scopo non può essere rivelato a nessuno. Si camuffa, ma Petre ed altri ragazzini capiscono subito chi sia in realtà. Ora che la sua missione è stata scoperta, a soli 5 secondi dl suo inizio, il suo “corso di appuntamenti” con Emilia potrebbe venire rovinato. Pre-screen nei cinema nipponici il 6 ottobre 2018.
